messages.text: hey ops — can we get Zendesk onboarded for a 90-day pilot? our shared support inbox is drowning since the Q3 launch and we want real ticketing + routing. thinking ~8 agents on it. site is zendesk.com. it'd basically hold all our customer support emails + chats so I guess yes it touches customer data. I'll own it on our side. would love to start asap, let me know what you need from me 🙏

Thanks Priya. I have almost everything for the Zendesk pilot. Two things:
1. What date do you want the pilot to start? "ASAP" can't go on the approval, so please give a calendar date.
2. Please confirm: Zendesk will touch customer data (customer support emails and chats). That means Security reviews it as well as your manager.
I've put you down as the business owner. Tell me if that should be someone else.
monday nov 2 works — gives us time to set up macros. and yep confirmed, customer emails + chat transcripts. me as owner is right.

pack.summary_for_approvers: Zendesk, Inc. is a well-known customer-support platform. For this pilot it would hold Acme customers' names, emails, and support conversations, so Security must review. On paper its security is strong: SOC 2 Type II (report only under NDA), several ISO certifications, a public sub-processor list, a public DPA with 48-hour breach notice, and SSO. Two things to decide: (1) data location is only guaranteed on Suite Professional or higher with the free add-on switched on, and (2) Zendesk uses sanitized customer data to train its own classification models. Estimated cost for 8 seats for 90 days on Suite Professional is about $3,576. No public price exists for Enterprise or for a 90-day pilot term.
questions_for_security: Do we require US data residency? If yes, the pilot must be Suite Professional with the Data Center Location add-on switched on.
Do we need the SOC 2 Type II report before signing? It needs an NDA, so the vendor must be contacted. That's outside this public-only research.

Is Zendesk's use of sanitized customer data to train its own classification models acceptable? Whether an opt-out exists: not found on the public pages checked (https://www.zendesk.com/trust-center/).
